note: Quests as data (4 Nov 2026, from Nevaland). A quest: steps the game watches (flag: 'character flag' the character remembers; has: 'item n' you carry; at: {x,z,r,name} in map units; knows: something a quest taught; rank: 'skill n' your rank with that skill's trainer), stations the named characters keep while it runs (map units), what it teaches (knowledge flags, scripts test them with quest:knows:x) and the next quest. It starts when its start condition is met (or by a reply's do:quest arg:'start id'). Progress is yours, saved with your things (OWNED 'quests'). The trainers' ladders (data/trainers.json) are the skills' own path; these are the stories over them.

Hand them to the Tomato by the park gate
